about_the_game:
Chart a Course to Global Shipping Enterprise

In Global Magnates, your success depends on smart, strategic planning. Master the art of global route optimization by analyzing supply and demand across ports, anticipating market shifts, and building the most profitable shipping lanes. Every decision brings you closer to becoming a logistics titan.

  •  Real-time route planning influenced by live market demand

  • Interactive global trade map with evolving port activity

Build Your Empire, Outsmart the Competition

Compete against AI-driven rival companies that will challenge your rise through takeovers, acquisitions, or price wars. Stay ahead by acquiring key ports, expanding your fleet, investing in shipyards, and making savvy economic moves. Outsmart opponents by mastering global trade, logistics, and dynamic market trends.

  • Advanced AI competitors with takeover strategies and market pressure

  • Dynamic business environment where every move counts

Deep Simulation, Real Strategy

Manage every aspect of your shipping business from purchasing vessels and designing routes to balancing regional demand and responding to economic events. Success demands sharp decision-making and smart resource allocation.

  • Full-scale management of ships, routes, ports, and resources

  • Responsive economic systems that reflect global and local trends

Cargo or Containers? Your Fleet, Your Strategy

Choose between customizable cargo ships and efficient container vessels. Optimize each ship's route and speed to maximize profits. As your business grows, build a diverse portfolio of assets from cutting-edge technology and capital to reputation and financial reserves.

  • Multiple ship classes with distinct advantages and customization options

  • Asset growth system including tech, capital, reputation, and infrastructure
detailed_description:
Dive into the Global Magnates Demo!

The Demo offers a guided introduction to Global Magnates, featuring a carefully designed gameplay sequence to help you quickly grasp the game's core mechanics. You'll experience the complete economic cycle and get hands-on with key systems like route planning, fleet management, and market dynamics. A full demo playthrough takes approximately 2 to 3 hours and offers understanding of the game's strategy and operations.

Please note that this Demo represents a current in-development version of the game. Our team is actively working on additional features and improvements for the full release. We sincerely appreciate your support and welcome your feedback, which is invaluable as we refine the final experience.
